text: If you take any cash or check payment, you must deposit it this way, every day.
Keep the day's cash and checks together as one deposit, with the printed deposit slip, for the bank.
Click Create deposit, under Quick actions.
Every cash and check payment not yet deposited is listed here.
Choose Skowhegan Savings or Bath Savings, whichever is closer to you.
And the date you take it to the bank.
Each cash and check payment, and who it was for.
The slip lists each check, and the total should match what's in your hand.
Scout posts the deposit and shows the slip.
Click Print deposit slip. Either bank accepts this printed slip, or even a slip of paper with our account number and the total you're depositing.
Then close it. The deposit is listed under Recent deposits, and the payments are gone from the undeposited list.
Even if you don't print the slip and use your own piece of paper, you must still create the deposit in Scout. Every cash and check payment goes into a deposit the same day.
